data.revised_prompt: 1:1 square educational app avatar icon asset, centered composition, bold silhouette, minimal detail, high contrast, readable at small sizes. Single fictional Chinese girl student age 8-14, 3D chibi style, soft polished materials, bright brown eyes, studio softbox lighting, clearly a student. Head-focused portrait, front or slight three-quarter view, full hair outline visible, face and hair occupy 75%-85% of frame, only a very small amount of neck and white school collar visible at bottom, absolutely not a half-body portrait. Hairstyle: ear-length mushroom cut with rounded blunt bangs, distinct full hair shape, a small yellow star hair clip on the left side. Expression: cheerful toothy smile. Clothing: only a tiny visible white school lapel collar, no emblem, no text. Background: solid low-saturation light emerald green, fully fills the entire square canvas edge-to-edge and corner-to-corner, no white border, no transparency, no circular frame, no ring, no halo, no scene elements. Extremely clear identity cues at 48px. Must look like a student avatar, not teacher or adult. Avoid: half body, upper body, full body, hands, gestures, props, teacher, adult, headset, headphones, suit, heavy makeup, jewelry, top of head cropped, hair cropped, chin cropped, face too small, off-center subject, large shoulders, white background, white border, transparent background, circular background, avatar frame, ring, strong halo, complex scene, text, letters, numbers, emblem, logo, watermark, multiple characters, photo-realistic, flat 2D illustration, baby proportions, dark tone, low resolution, deformed facial features.
